# Allow-list for scripts/check-spelling: British forms that are not
# user-facing text and must not change.
# One entry per line, at the line's start: PATH-ERE TOKEN-ERE  # why
# (the reason is required; neither ERE may contain a space).
# The token is removed from matching lines of files whose path matches,
# before the check looks again. Tokens are case-sensitive.
